LoadPngFile: Please select the png file to load, then press OK to proceed.
ResetDescription: Reset current image all parameters to their default values.
TextureTransformModeDescription: This option affects how PNG images are displayed. FlipVertical is the high-performance mode, while Transpose is the legacy compatibility mode. It can only be changed before entering the game.
ModDescription: Overlay images on top of the map, allowing you to replicate real city.
ResetWarning: Are you sure you want to reset to the default parameters?
Changelog_v1_8_4_Updated: Updated to the latest common framework.
Changelog_v1_8_5_Fixed: Fixed an issue where placing PNG files after loading the game would not display images.
Changelog_v1_8_5_Fixed1: Fixed an issue with incorrect PNG folder directory in the option panel under OSX system.
Changelog_v1_8_5_Updated1: UUI button and separate tool button are now optional.
Changelog_v1_9_0_Added: Added independent support for multiple image parameters.
Changelog_v1_9_0_Added1: Added support for looping image shortcuts.
Changelog_v1_10_0_Attention: This update automatically resets all settings.
Changelog_v1_10_0_Optimized: Optimized algorithm logic to improve texture processing speed.
Changelog_v1_10_0_Fixed: Resolved unpredictable image inversion triggered when switching between images.
Changelog_v1_10_1_Fixed: Fixed the issue where the control panel cannot be invoked in the map editor mode.
Changelog_v1_10_2_Optimized: Optimized slow performance when switching between different images.
Changelog_v1_10_2_Optimized1: Optimized several controls in the control panel.
Changelog_v1_10_3_Optimized: Optimized opacity adjustment for various PNG texture formats.
Changelog_v1_10_3_Fixed: Fixed the incorrect mod description issue.
Changelog_v1_11_0_Optimized: Improved opacity switching performance for faster and smoother transitions.
Changelog_v1_11_0_Optimized1: Opacity settings no longer require applying the opacity value to take effect.
Changelog_v1_11_0_Optimized2: Removed the default behavior of loading all available images when loading the game, images are now loaded only when manually selected.
Changelog_v1_11_0_Optimized3: Image loading is now manual and supports selecting individual image files.
Changelog_v1_11_0_Added: Added the Preserve Aspect Ratio option. For non‑square images, the control now supports both stretching and preserving the original aspect ratio.
Changelog_v1_11_0_Added1: Now works in the Asset Editor.
